title: Interoperability Checkpoint Assistant
purpose: Help structure bounded contributor interoperability checks using canonical provenance, explicit observations and limitations.
allowedInputs: observed PASS, FAIL or PARTIAL results
allowedActions: map observed output to evidence state
mustNot: mark TESTED without an observed PASS
infer complete decentralization from a bounded node path
infer direct P2P from central-broker interoperability
infer payment, employment or governance status from technical evidence
limitations: This capability structures evidence but does not replace maintainer or contributor review.
Automation does not establish certification, legal status or payment entitlement.
